m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: See? I told you our campaign to take the Manor would succeed. The Tabbis are arriving even now to switch with us and move into the Manse.
Are you daft, Spitamenes? Do you see any luggage? Don't you think we'd be forewarned? I don't think that's why the Tabbi is here.
No. We are here for our House Chronoshard. Hand it over, and we will leave peacefully.
You will leave, but it won't be peacefully! Spitamenes and I will remind you of why Purrzians will always be superior to Tabbis!
I'll never understand how the Purrzians maintain this delusion of grandeur. Yes, they once ruled Mirage, but it's been centuries.
The Djinni, Istar, told me of their dangerous scheme to resurrect Xerxes and the trouble that's caused. It's disappointing, as is this mess.
Meow! How dare you interrupt my grooming appointment? I was about to get my nails trimmed and my ears cleaned out. You'll pay for this! Guards!
Yet more evidence to support my theory that all Purrzian Qhats are narcissists. Who knows, though? Perhaps the Duke will prove an exception.
Oh, is someone finally here with my bowl of warm milk? Wait... what's a Tabbi doing in here? Scat, you! Fine, I'll dirty my claws if I must!
Hold, I relent! But it doesn't invalidate our claim. House Purrzian remains the rightful ruler of all Mirage. We've never conceded otherwise.
I am not oblivious to the realities, however, and I am open to temporary compromise... but we must talk outside the Manse. Come!
As you might imagine, I can speak far more freely outside the earshot of my fellow Purrzians. Have to keep up a hardline appearance, of course.
And as to you, young Atraydies... did you honestly expect to walk in from the desert and be handed the lordship like some kind of treat?
I have the right by blood, Crowl. I passed the Binny Jezzerit's trials, and I finally rid us of the Great Wurm Melanj.
He speaks truly. Despite his defiance in attacking Melanj, the Reverend Mother supports Atraydies' claim. It is your duty to step aside, Count.
I will do no such thing. You Sisters can say Atraydies has the better breeding, but Murdak correct me if I'm wrong, mustn't they show proof?
Hm... what? Oh, yes... I believe that is true. Yes. To settle such matters, we've always consulted the House Chronoshard...
Which has always been held in good faith by our vassal... and with House Purrzian in open rebellion, I fear we are at an impasse.
I think not. The Wizard and I can swiftly remedy the situation. We will go to the Vassal Manse and retrieve the House Chronoshard by force.
So you intend to storm the Vassal Manse and take on House Purrzian by yourselves? Very well, Atraydies' death will settle this matter too.
